item.title: TeleRedi to take your calls!
item.description: We are pretty well-accustomed to periods of extreme heat here in WA, but when the heat gets too much, who do we turn to? TeleRedi is Australian Red Cross’s free phone support service – it provides critical support for people living in Australia who may be at risk during extreme heat events. item.title: WA Made Film Festival
item.description: The WA Made Film Festival is a celebration of Western Australian screen culture, and is about to present its biggest-ever lineup of films to date. The festival opened on Thursday 19th February with the WA premiere of the highly-anticipated horror-thriller Proclivitas. The festival runs through until Sunday 1st March. Beth Mackiewicz chats with Matthew Eeles. The post WA Made Film Festival appeared first on RTRFM.

item.title: Under Waters
